description: Change one video in a video surface: swap its file (`url`), rename it, relabel it, or move it in the play order (`position`; pass only `position` to reorder). Get `video_id` from `list_videos`. Omitted fields stay as they are. Returns `url`, the Dock link that opens this video. Editor role required. Emits `video.updated`.

content_type.description: Optional content type for a new `url` without an extension.

position.description: Optional new place in the play order, zero-based: 0 puts it first. A number past the end puts it last.

slug.description: The workspace slug. Accepts bare or org-prefixed form.

surface_slug.description: Optional video surface slug. Omit for the first video surface.

url.description: Optional new https URL (mp4, webm, mov or m4v).

name: update_video
